changelog:
Initial release: Polish & structure a technical blog with en-US clarity and generate consistent hero + section image prompts.

- Polishes technical blog drafts into a 1000–1200 word, 3–4 section en-US article while preserving technical accuracy.
- Automatically generates consistent image prompts for a hero image and each section, reusing user-specified or default style/background/aspect ratio.
- Saves the polished markdown and generated image prompts/paths to the output directory with a timestamped filename.
- Supports customizable input for draft location, output directory, subject slug, visual style, background, and aspect ratios.
- Designed for technical workflows requiring both content polish and a matched set of illustration prompts.
summary: Polish a technical blog draft into an 1000–1200 word, 4-5 section en-US article, preserve technical terms/code, and generate consistent hero + per-section image prompts when the user asks to polish and translate a blog with images.
